```
def build_other_options_msg(fix_version: Optional[str], is_spec: bool,
    secure_options: List[str]) ->str:
    if not secure_options:
        return ""
    
    options_str = ", ".join(secure_options)
    count = len(secure_options)
    
    if count == 1:
        version_word = "version"
        verb = "is"
    else:
        version_word = "versions"
        verb = "are"
        
    return f" Other {version_word} without known vulnerabilities {verb}: {options_str}"
```
